newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey seizes 84 kg of heroin in southeast.
newsitem.headline: Turkey seizes 84 kg of heroin in southeast.

text.p: Turkish security forces have seized 84 kg (185 lb) of heroin hidden on a lorry in the southeast of the country, a military official said on Tuesday.
The heroin haul has a local market value of $515,000, the official told Reuters.
Gendarmes found the heroin on Monday in the tyres of the truck in a town in Hakkari province, he said.
He said police had detained the driver of the truck, which according to the state-run Anatolian news agency belongs to the Yuksekova town council.

Turkey is on the Balkan route, used to transport narcotics from Afghanistan and Pakistan across Iran and northern Iraq to Europe either by land through Istanbul and Thrace or by sea from the western Turkish port of Izmir.
In 1996, Turkish police seized 4.422 tonnes of heroin out of global seizures of 11 tonnes, according to official Turkish figures.
